name: nyc-hourly-zone-demand-forecast
purpose: Publish a governed one-to-168-hour forecast of Yellow Taxi pickup counts for every available NYC Taxi Zone.
triggers: An operator invokes the governed NYC hourly demand forecast workflow with approved demand history and production model artifacts
not_for: Fare, tip, driver-income, or passenger-demand prediction
Real-time dispatch, vehicle routing, or autonomous fleet allocation
Forecasting from ungoverned raw trip files or beyond a 168-hour horizon
Treating predictions as guaranteed demand or current regulatory advice

stages: changes to data, model, or publication gates
authorization to run production model, forecast, deployment, or scheduling workflows
human_review.reason: Static checks and deterministic quality gates provide evidence but cannot authorize production execution, artifact replacement, deployment, or scheduling.
